title: Testing
tagline: Build confidence in software through evidence, disciplined test design, and reliable automation
summary: A comprehensive textbook on software testing: fundamentals and oracles; unit, component, integration, contract, API, database, browser and end-to-end testing; test doubles; test data and determinism; property-based, fuzz, mutation, regression, exploratory, accessibility, visual, performance and security testing; async and distributed systems; test architecture; TDD/BDD; CI pipelines; release risk; and practical testing workflows for JavaScript, Python, React, APIs, CLIs, and services. The goal is not to maximize test counts, but to reason about what each test proves, where confidence comes from, and what risk remains.
topics: Integration, API, contract, and database testing
JavaScript, Python, React, HTTP, CLI and worker testing
